dct_title_s: Hartley Lake Quadrangle, Minnesota-Itasca County, 1971: 7.5 Minute Series Orthophoto Map (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Hartley Lake quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9315/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area between Lawrence Lake East and Horsehead Lake. The hand written notations include information on the following logging camps noted with 'C'.
